paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.
model_annotation: This 3D bar chart illustrates the metric of answer correctness across different language models and classification tasks. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Davinci-003,” “ChatGPT,” and “BARD,” arranged in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and displays values ranging from 0.0 to 0.9, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 0.9. The third axis, pointing into the page, is labeled “Classification” and “Generation” alongside an arrow indicating its direction and has no numerical scale. Six bars are displayed, with each bar representing a combination of language model and task. The bars representing Davinci-003 and Classification have an approximate height of 0.8, while the bars representing ChatGPT and Classification and BARD and Generation have an approximate height of 0.2. The bars are colored using a gradient scale from blue to yellow, with the hue varying for each bar. While no bars are explicitly emphasized through shading or outlining, the bars systematically transition in color from blue to yellow across the different combinations of model and task.
